key.name: enabled
key.description: Whether SnapTile remembers where application windows were and puts new windows there. Off: nothing is remembered or placed, and what is stored stays until it is cleared.

key.name: places
key.description: The size and position SnapTile remembers per application, as one JSON text. Unreadable text counts as nothing remembered.

key.name: thirds-shortcuts
key.description: Whether the keyboard shortcuts for the left, middle and right third are active. Off: the keys go to the applications again.

key.name: tile-left-third
key.description: Keyboard shortcut that snaps the focused window into the left third of its monitor. An empty list switches the shortcut off.

key.name: tile-middle-third
key.description: Keyboard shortcut that snaps the focused window into the middle third of its monitor. An empty list switches the shortcut off.

key.name: tile-right-third
key.description: Keyboard shortcut that snaps the focused window into the right third of its monitor. An empty list switches the shortcut off.
